_note: Source:ItemView is a COLLECTION name, not a SQL view. Views are refused: a Mongo view can redact per caller, and the driver cannot tell a redacting view from a plain one.
Documents must carry _id, title, body, status, owner, and isDeleted when SoftDeleteEnabled is true.
updatedAt is optional but strongly wanted: without it there is no resume marker, because an ObjectId encodes creation time and not modification time, so every crawl is a full crawl.
A field under CSFLE or Queryable Encryption stops the run. Ciphertext indexes silently and is useless - exclude the field or decrypt it into a materialised collection.
